questions.question: Sell the House
answers: When my husband Johnny was promoted, we put our house up for sale. One day the doorbell rang unexpectedly in the morning. Our agent Jack stood at the door with a couple from New York. The three people saw the dirty dishes on the kitchen table. They went into a bedroom with unmade beds. I heard the couple laughing when I went to the bathroom to comb my hair. The agent told me the couple had bought my house two days later. The buyer said my house had a warm, lived-in feeling.

When my husband Johnny was promoted, we put our house up for sale. One day the doorbell rang unexpectedly early in the morning. It was our agent Jack and a couple from New York. I had no time to clear up the mess made that morning before they walked in. They saw the dirty dishes on the kitchen table as well as the unmade beds in the bedroom. I heard the couple laughing when I went to the bathroom to comb my hair. Two days later the agent told me the couple had bought my house. The couple said my house had a warm, lived-in feeling.
